title: A stuffed doll or toy receives a hug
summary: Most children hug a stuffed doll or another toy by about 15 months, the milestone sheet says.
body: The hug is directed at fabric or a toy, not at a person. sheet lists that separately from affection toward the caregiver. The gesture does not show that the child thinks the toy has feelings. The page's majority is 75 percent or more, the materials are not a validated screen, and the month comes from the US checklist alone.

sources.title: Milestones by 15 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Hugs stuffed doll or other toy'.
